WEBSITES / 6 MIN READ

Before you build: a better website brief

A practical starting point for turning a business goal into a useful website.

EasyOra Editorial · Practical guide

Start with the job your website needs to do

A website can introduce a business, generate enquiries, sell products, or support existing customers. Pick the primary job first. A clear goal helps you choose content and features without turning every possible idea into a requirement.

Know who is visiting

Write down your main audience, what they need to know, and the questions they ask before deciding. Organize the site around their journey, using familiar language and clear navigation.

Prepare the essentials

Gather your logo, service descriptions, product information, contact details, and images you have permission to use. Decide who will write and approve content. Content readiness affects both the schedule and the quality of the result.

Define what is included

List the pages, forms, integrations, and editing needs. Agree on deliverables, review rounds, responsibilities, and acceptance criteria before work begins. Separate essentials for launch from improvements that can follow.

Plan for life after launch

Choose who will update content and handle maintenance. Agree how you will assess whether the website is helping: useful enquiries, completed purchases, or fewer support questions are more informative than a visitor count alone.

Turn the ideas into a plan.
